claims.explanation: Zardaverine is a dual PDE3/PDE4 inhibitor that raises cAMP; selectivity likely reflects dependence on cAMP-hydrolyzing PDE4 activity and/or intact cAMP-PKA signaling, so lines with high PDE4D expression or active cAMP-dependent growth/survival signaling are sensitized, while lines with mutations that bypass or blunt cAMP signaling (e.g., PTEN loss, NF1 loss, BRAF/NRAS activation) are protected. The observed pattern is enriched for BRAF-mutant melanoma and KRAS-mutant pancreatic/colorectal lines, consistent with MAPK-driven tumors being more dependent on cAMP-mediated feedback, whereas PTEN/NF1-mutant and mesenchymal/Ewing lines are less affected.

features.basis: primary drug target; higher PDE4D expression increases dependence on PDE4-mediated cAMP hydrolysis
BRAF-mutant melanoma lines (IGR37, UACC62, K029AX, LOXIMVI) are among the most killed; cAMP/PDE4 inhibition can suppress MAPK-driven survival
KRAS-mutant pancreatic/colorectal lines (T3M4, SNU410, CL11, OV7) are enriched among sensitive lines
PTEN-mutant lines (UACC62, KALS1, HEC265, ZR751, 786O, FTC133) appear in both extremes but several are least affected; PTEN loss may blunt cAMP-dependent growth inhibition
NF1-mutant lines (KALS1, LOXIMVI, BICR6, FTC133, S117) include several least-affected lines, suggesting RAS/MAPK activation can bypass cAMP-mediated growth suppression
TP53 mutation is common in both extremes but enriched in least-affected lines, consistent with loss of p53-mediated apoptosis limiting drug response
CDKN2A-mutant lines (K029AX, IPC298, MHHES1, SNU1214) include several least-affected lines, suggesting cell-cycle deregulation reduces dependence on cAMP-mediated arrest
EGFR-mutant NSCLC lines (NCIH1650, NCIH1648, HCC4006) appear in both extremes but several are least affected, possibly due to EGFR-driven survival bypassing cAMP control
PIK3CA-mutant lines (SNU840, MKN1, HGC27, SNUC5, KYSE510) include several least-affected lines, suggesting PI3K activation can compensate for cAMP-mediated inhibition
ARID1A-mutant lines (LOXIMVI, HEC265, SNUC5, KU1919) include several least-affected lines, possibly via chromatin remodeling that alters cAMP-responsive transcription
KMT2D-mutant lines (HEC265, BICR6, KYSE270, KE39, SNUC5, KU1919) are enriched among least-affected lines
ATM-mutant lines (SNU685, 786O, SNUC5) include least-affected lines, suggesting altered DNA-damage response may reduce drug sensitivity
